title: List Devices
description: List all available devices. This includes both physical mobile devices and mobile simulators and emulators. It returns both Android and iOS devices. These are local devices already connected to this machine, ready to use immediately at no cost - for devices from the shared remote cloud fleet, use mobile_list_remote_devices instead.
name: mobile_list_available_devices

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: List Apps
description: List all the installed apps on the device
name: mobile_list_apps

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Get Foreground App
description: Get the app currently in the foreground on the device, including the focused activity class on Android or view controller class on iOS when available. Use this to verify which app or screen you are on before interacting with it.
name: mobile_get_foreground_app

locale.description: Comma-separated BCP 47 locale tags to launch the app with (e.g., fr-FR,en-GB)

packageName.description: The package name of the app to launch

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Launch App
description: Launch an app on mobile device. Use this to open a specific app. You can find the package name of the app by calling mobile_list_apps.
name: mobile_launch_app

packageName.description: The package name of the app to terminate

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Terminate App
description: Stop and terminate an app on mobile device
name: mobile_terminate_app

packageName.description: The package name (Android) or bundle id (iOS) of the app to clear

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Clear App Data
description: Clear an app's data, such as its cache, documents, preferences and databases, and stop the app, so the next launch starts as if freshly installed. The app stays installed. Supported on Android devices and emulators and on iOS simulators, not on real iOS devices.
name: mobile_clear_app_data

path.description: The path to the app file to install. For iOS simulators, provide a .zip file or a .app directory. For Android provide an .apk file. For iOS real devices provide an .ipa file

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Install App
description: Install an app on mobile device
name: mobile_install_app

packageName.description: The package name of the app to uninstall

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Uninstall App
description: Uninstall an app from mobile device
name: mobile_uninstall_app

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Get Screen Size
description: Get the screen size of the mobile device in pixels
name: mobile_get_screen_size

y.description: The y coordinate to click on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

x.description: The x coordinate to click on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

ref.description: Element ref from mobile_list_elements_on_screen, e.g. "@e5". Takes precedence over x,y

title: Click Screen
description: Click on the screen, either at x,y coordinates or on an element by its ref (e.g. "@e5") from the latest mobile_list_elements_on_screen result. Prefer ref when the element is listed.
name: mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates

y.description: The y coordinate to double-tap, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

x.description: The x coordinate to double-tap, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

ref.description: Element ref from mobile_list_elements_on_screen, e.g. "@e5". Takes precedence over x,y

title: Double Tap Screen
description: Double-tap on the screen, either at x,y coordinates or on an element by its ref (e.g. "@e5") from the latest mobile_list_elements_on_screen result. Prefer ref when the element is listed.
name: mobile_double_tap_on_screen

duration.description: Duration of the long press in milliseconds. Defaults to 500ms.

y.description: The y coordinate to long press on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

x.description: The x coordinate to long press on the screen, in pixels. Required unless ref is given

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

ref.description: Element ref from mobile_list_elements_on_screen, e.g. "@e5". Takes precedence over x,y

title: Long Press Screen
description: Long press on the screen, either at x,y coordinates or on an element by its ref (e.g. "@e5") from the latest mobile_list_elements_on_screen result. Prefer ref when the element is listed.
name: mobile_long_press_on_screen_at_coordinates

format.description: Output format. "text" (default) is one compact line per element, "json" is a json array, "raw" is the unfiltered platform-specific hierarchy as JSON (mobilecli only). Raw nodes may be offscreen and do not have element refs

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: List Screen Elements
description: List elements on screen with their ref, coordinates, and display text or accessibility label. Use the ref with mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates, mobile_double_tap_on_screen or mobile_long_press_on_screen_at_coordinates. Refs and coordinates stay valid as long as the screen does not change; re-list only after navigation or a layout change.
name: mobile_list_elements_on_screen

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

button.description:
The button to press, in upper case. Supported buttons:
Android: HOME, BACK, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, ENTER, BACKSPACE, APP_SWITCH, POWER, DPAD_CENTER, DPAD_UP, DPAD_DOWN, DPAD_LEFT, DPAD_RIGHT
iOS: HOME, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, ENTER, LOCK
BACKSPACE deletes the character before the cursor, APP_SWITCH opens the recent apps, POWER turns the screen on or off, LOCK locks the screen, and the DPAD buttons move focus on Android TV.

title: Press Button
description: Press a button on device
name: mobile_press_button

url.description: The URL to open, starting with http:// or https://

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Open URL
description: Open an http:// or https:// URL in the browser on device. Other URL schemes, such as app deep links, are rejected unless the server was started with MOBILEMCP_ALLOW_UNSAFE_URLS=1.
name: mobile_open_url

distance.description: The distance to swipe in pixels. Defaults to 400 pixels for iOS or 30% of screen dimension for Android

y.description: The y coordinate to start the swipe from, in pixels. Give both x and y, or neither to start from the center of screen

x.description: The x coordinate to start the swipe from, in pixels. Give both x and y, or neither to start from the center of screen

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Swipe Screen
description: Swipe on the screen
name: mobile_swipe_on_screen

submit.description: Whether to submit the text. If true, the text will be submitted as if the user pressed the enter key. Defaults to false

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Type Text
description: Type text into the focused element
name: mobile_type_keys

saveTo.description: The path to save the screenshot to. Filename must end with .png, .jpg, or .jpeg

scale.description: Scale factor (0.0-1.0). Ignored if maxSize is provided.

maxSize.description: Maximum width/height in pixels, keeping aspect ratio. Omit for full size.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Save Screenshot
description: Save a screenshot of the mobile device to a file
name: mobile_save_screenshot

scale.description: Scale factor (0.0-1.0). Ignored if maxSize is provided.

maxSize.description: Maximum width/height in pixels, keeping aspect ratio. Defaults to 1024.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Take Screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the mobile device. Use this to understand what's on screen, if you need to press an element that is available through view hierarchy then you must list elements on screen instead. The screenshot is usually smaller than the screen, so when the device reports its screen size the result also states how to convert positions in the screenshot into screen coordinates before tapping. Do not cache this result.
name: mobile_take_screenshot

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Set Orientation
description: Change the screen orientation of the device
name: mobile_set_orientation

angle.description: The desired hinge angle in degrees, between 0 (folded) and 180 (open). iOS only, e.g. iPhone Duo. Use instead of posture.

posture.description: The desired hinge posture: folded (0 degrees), half-open (90 degrees) or open (180 degrees)

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Fold Device
description: Fold or unfold a foldable device, such as iPhone Duo simulators and foldable Android emulators. Provide either posture or angle.
name: mobile_fold_device

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. -122.4194. Omit together with latitude to clear the override.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 37.7749. Omit together with longitude to clear the override.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Set Location
description: Override the GPS location reported by the device, or clear the override to restore the real location. Omit latitude and longitude to clear.
name: mobile_set_location

text.description: Text to place on the clipboard. Omit to read the clipboard instead.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Clipboard
description: Read or replace the device clipboard. Pass text to set the clipboard, omit it to read the current clipboard.
name: mobile_clipboard

saveTo.description: Path to write the logs to instead of returning them. Filename must end with .log, .txt, or .jsonl

filter.description: Filters, ANDed together. key=value includes, key!=value excludes. Keys: pid, process, tag, level, subsystem, category, message. Example: ["tag=ActivityManager", "level=Error", "process!=SpringBoard"]

limit.description: Stop after this many log entries

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Get Device Logs
description: Collect live device logs (logcat on Android, unified log on iOS) as one JSON object per line. Only logs emitted after the call starts are captured, so trigger the behavior you want to observe right before or during the call. Stops after `limit` entries or after 30 seconds of silence. Each line of a stack trace counts as one entry, so filter by process or tag to avoid filling the limit with noise. Start with a small limit (20-50) for a quick look. For large captures, pass `saveTo` to write logs to a file and only the entry count is returned.
name: mobile_get_device_logs

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Get Orientation
description: Get the current screen orientation of the device
name: mobile_get_orientation

timeLimit.description: Maximum recording duration in seconds. The recording will stop automatically after this time.

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

output.description: The file path to save the recording to. Filename must end with .mp4. If not provided, a temporary path will be used.

title: Start Screen Recording
description: Start recording the screen of a mobile device. The recording runs in the background until stopped with mobile_stop_screen_recording. Returns the path where the recording will be saved.
name: mobile_start_screen_recording

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Stop Screen Recording
description: Stop an active screen recording on a mobile device. Returns the file path, size, and approximate duration of the recording.
name: mobile_stop_screen_recording

name: mobile_get_crash

name.description: Name of a tool allowed as a step, e.g. mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates

arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, same as calling it directly

stopOnError.description: Stop at the first failing step. Defaults to true

device.description: The device identifier to use. Use mobile_list_available_devices to find which devices are available to you.

title: Batch Commands
description: Run multiple tools in sequence in a single call, e.g. click, type, click, type. Use this to fill forms or perform multi-step flows without round-trips. The device argument is applied to every step unless a step provides its own. Tools allowed as steps: mobile_list_available_devices, mobile_login_to_cloud_provider, mobile_list_remote_devices, mobile_allocate_remote_device, mobile_release_remote_device, mobile_list_apps, mobile_get_foreground_app, mobile_launch_app, mobile_terminate_app, mobile_clear_app_data, mobile_install_app, mobile_uninstall_app, mobile_get_screen_size, mobile_click_on_screen_at_coordinates, mobile_double_tap_on_screen, mobile_long_press_on_screen_at_coordinates, mobile_list_elements_on_screen, mobile_press_button, mobile_open_url, mobile_swipe_on_screen, mobile_type_keys, mobile_save_screenshot, mobile_set_orientation, mobile_fold_device, mobile_set_location, mobile_clipboard, mobile_get_device_logs, mobile_get_orientation, mobile_start_screen_recording, mobile_stop_screen_recording, mobile_list_crashes, mobile_get_crash.
name: mobile_batch_commands
